rules.title: Annual Allowable Rent Increase
rules.requirement: Landlords of rent-controlled units in San Francisco may increase rent by only a set annual percentage set by the Rent Board each year.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rent-controlled units under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span:
Allowable Rent Increase:
1.6% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is subject to San Francisco rent control (e.g. certificate of occupancy date and other Rent Ordinance coverage criteria not stated in this chunk)

rules.title: Security Deposit Interest Rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay tenants interest on security deposits at a rate set annually by the Rent Board.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to security deposits held for rental units covered by the Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span:
Security Deposit Interest:
4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027

rules.title: Relocation Payments for No-Fault Evictions (Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, Substantial Rehabilitation)
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation are entitled to relocation payments per tenant, with a maximum per unit and additional amounts for elderly, disabled tenants, or households with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; max $24,733.00 per unit; +$5,497.00 for elderly/disabled/minor child household
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to units subject to the Rent Ordinance where eviction notice is for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act are entitled to relocation payments per tenant, with a maximum per unit and additional amounts for elderly or disabled tenants.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; max $33,330.13 per unit; +$7,443.90 for elderly (62+)/disabled
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to units subject to the Rent Ordinance where eviction is under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of rental units from the market).
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
